Use the actual prior Script75 snapshot tick instead of assuming targetOnsetTick - 1.
Confirm the raw null-to-expected-player m_hVacuumTarget transition.

semanticLimits.vacuumTarget: m_hVacuumTarget remains observed target telemetry. The strong null-to-player transition and subsequent inactivity support vacuum semantics but do not constitute engine documentation.
semanticLimits.geometry: Distances are raw replay entity-origin distances. Strict 3D requires valid Z telemetry for both target pawn and AssignedGold; XY is reported separately.
semanticLimits.threshold: Observed containment and crossing counts identify an empirical single-replay envelope. They do not establish an exact engine constant without replication and outlier resolution.
semanticLimits.bestCrossing: The threshold maximizing previous-outside/onset-inside crossings is descriptive and must not override reliable onset distances above that threshold.

interpretationGuide.rawUpgrade: This is the requested replacement of 4Hz interpolated player geometry with exact raw replay geometry at the vacuum-target transition.
interpretationGuide.hardBoundary: A candidate hard radius must be at least as large as the highest reliable onset geometry in the relevant metric. Crossing-count optima below reliable onset observations cannot be treated as the radius.
interpretationGuide.metricChoice: If XY produces a materially tighter boundary than 3D, the vacuum condition may be primarily planar or entity-origin Z may add irrelevant vertical separation. That remains a mechanic hypothesis until replicated.
interpretationGuide.next: After this result, resolve any small set of extreme onset cases. If the clean raw envelope is stable, then promote a single-replay candidate vacuum radius and move to the structured targetless lifetime schedule.
